query: Microsoft Azure Q2 fiscal 2026 revenue growth AI contribution latest earnings
normalized: 2026 ai azure contribution earnings fiscal growth microsoft q2 revenue

output.content:
Microsoft’s latest reported quarter was fiscal Q2 2026, ended December 31, 2025 and released January 28, 2026. [[1]]

- **Azure growth:** Azure and other cloud services revenue grew **39% year over year**, or **38% in constant currency**, versus **40% reported / 39% constant currency** in fiscal Q1 2026. [[1]] [[2]]
- **AI contribution:** Microsoft did **not disclose a separate AI percentage-point contribution** to Azure’s 39% growth in its Q2 materials. It said Azure growth was driven by demand across its services portfolio and continued growth across all workloads, while defining Azure and other cloud services as including cloud and AI consumption-based services. [[3]] [[4]]
- **Broader cloud results:** Intelligent Cloud revenue was **$32.9 billion**, up **29%** year over year, and Microsoft Cloud revenue reached **$51.5 billion**, up **26%**. [[5]]
- **AI demand and constraints:** Management said demand continued to exceed available supply, and noted that efficiency gains in its fungible fleet allowed capacity to be reallocated to monetized Azure demand during the quarter. [[5]]
- **Profitability implication:** Microsoft said Microsoft Cloud gross margin was **67%**, with the year-over-year decline reflecting continuing AI-infrastructure investment and increased AI-product usage, partly offset by Azure and Microsoft 365 efficiency gains. [[5]] 

In short, Azure expanded at a still-exceptional **39% reported growth rate**, but decelerated modestly from Q1; AI is clearly embedded in the growth narrative and infrastructure spending, yet Microsoft did not provide the precise “AI contribution” figure it had disclosed in some earlier periods. [[2]] [[6]]
